about: The Kokoro voices media-render carries (PRD-262 US-052): the ids of the catalogue the platform offers, KOKORO_VOICES in orchestrator/modules/socials/kokoro_voices.py, in its order. They are copied here because the media-render build context (services/media-render, for compose and Railway alike) cannot read the orchestrator; orchestrator/tests/test_prd262_media_render_voices.py keeps the two equal. The image build rewrites voices-v1.0.bin to these voices alone after its sha256 check (media_render/voices_build.py), and the service refuses any voice its voices file does not hold.
